description: US (NTSC-U) Nintendo 3DS retail game case (CTR): white opaque PP keep case, landscape, clear outer film, book style (spine on the left seen from the front), 2 manual clips on the lid, one card holder in the tray centre, no GBA slot
units: file: metres (metersPerUnit 1, upAxis Y); every value in this JSON is mm unless the key says otherwise
frame: case closed, standing, front cover +Z, spine -X; root CTR_CASE = bottom centre of the closed bbox

hinges_mm.note: hinge lines run along Y on the outer spine corners; CASE_SPINE_HINGE sits on the back line rotated pi about X; CASE_LID sits at local (0, 0, -12) under CASE_SPINE

motion_rad.fully_open_mm: tray | spine | lid flat, inner faces up, outer faces at z = -6, x -214.5 .. 67.5 (135 + 12 + 135)

insert_placement_mm.folds: back|spine fold on the back/spine outer corner (x -67.5, z -6), spine|front fold on the front/spine outer corner (x -67.5, z +6)

gametdb_coverfullHQ.note: insert_mm = 276 mm x (777, 70, 769) / 1616 rounded to 0.1 mm; height 680 px = 116.14 mm -> 116.1. A full 1616 x 680 scan used as the texture as-is maps 1:1: fold error <= 0.23 px, aspect error 0.03 %

banner: NOT modelled: the vertical white 'NINTENDO 3DS' strip (about 13-15 mm) at the far right of the FRONT panel is part of the paper insert and is drawn by the app into the texture (u about 0.948 .. 1.0)

medium_anchor.axes: +Z = card label-face normal (toward the lid), +Y = card up (label reads upright, contact edge at -Y), +X = key-tab side
medium_anchor.origin: centre of the 33 x 35 x 3.8 card body (key tab excluded); label face at anchor z +1.9, back face at -1.9

medium.measured_notes: body x -16.5..16.5; key tab x 16.5..17.5, y 11.2..14.8; label/front face z 0 (raised 3DS platform to +0.043); back face z -3.8 (molded marks to -3.915); contacts/PCB window at -Y

card_holder.hooks_rel_anchor: right corners y +-(14.5..17.5), left nubs y +-(7..11); overhang 1.2 mm over the card, underside 0.085 mm above the label face

manual_clips.note: tongue from the free-edge side of each window toward the spine, raised head with a lip toward the spine

layout_mm.trademark_emboss: tray: plain-text 'Nintendo 3DS' (Blender built-in font, NOT a traced logo), vertical, centre (44, 61), in TRADEMARK_PRINTS
